summary: Wraps the imported IsBadReadPtr check: returns the logical negation of IsBadReadPtr(lp, ucb), i.e. true when the given range is readable. The ABI lead labels this function IsBadReadPtr_Wrapper.

operations.description: Invoke the imported IsBadReadPtr global (0x59E080) with the two parameters (lp, ucb) passed to this function.
Negate the IsBadReadPtr result so a readable range yields a non-zero BOOL.

unresolved: The subsystem that consumes this readability gate is unknown; callers sub_5934E1 and sub_5939F9 are the only linking evidence.
IsBadReadPtr is referenced as an imported global rather than a resolved callee, so the exact import mechanism is unresolved.
